meta.name: story-import
meta.description: 逆向导入已有小说。将已写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析为标准项目目录结构，兼容 story-long-write / story-short-write 后续写作流程；内部复用 story-long-analyze / story-short-analyze 的拆解管道，按篇幅自动分流。触发方式：/story-import、「导入小说」「反向解析」「导入」「把我的书导进来」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把已写好或写了一半的小说导进写作项目,接着往下写
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有完本或半成品小说,想放进统一流程继续创作。
copy.tagline_en: Import your finished or half-written novel into a project and keep writing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a finished or half-written novel and want to keep writing it in one flow.

howto.what: 把已经写好或写了一半的小说反向解析成可续写的写作工程：先拆解成拆文库分析资产，再迁移成设定、大纲、正文、追踪等标准项目结构，长篇短篇自动分流。
howto.when: 当你说「导入小说」「反向解析」「把我的书导进来」等，或运行 /story-import 并提供文件路径或直接贴文本时接管。

say.text: 把我的书导进来，做成能续写的写作工程
say.note: 先判长篇短篇，拆解后迁移成项目结构

say.text: 导入这本小说，我只要一份拆文库分析，不用建工程
say.note: 只走到拆文库，不做结构迁移

say.text: 我这本是半成品，写到第 80 章，帮我导入续写
say.note: 残稿会先问你续写还是先补完

howto.what_en: Turns a finished or half-written novel into a resumable writing project: it analyzes the book into a 拆文库 asset set, then migrates it into standard project folders (设定/大纲/正文/追踪), routing long vs short works automatically.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say things like 导入小说 or 反向解析, or run /story-import with a file path or pasted text.

say_en.text: Import my book and turn it into a resumable writing project
say_en.note: Auto-detects length, then migrates to project structure

say_en.text: Import this novel, I only want the analysis, no project
My book is half-written at chapter 80, import it to continue
say_en.note: It asks: continue from the draft or finish it first
